description_en: Queries the status of a real-time synchronization task or a data synchronization solution
description_zh: 获取实时同步任务和同步解决方案任务的运行状态
name: GetDISyncInstanceInfo

parameters.help_en:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object that you want to query. Valid values:

DI_REALTIME: real-time synchronization task
DI_SOLUTION: data synchronization solution
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所关联的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。取值如下：

DI_REALTIME：表示数据集成实时同步任务。
DI_SOLUTION：表示数据集成同步解决方案
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
If you set the TaskType parameter to DI_REALTIME, set the FileId parameter to the ID of the real-time synchronization task that you want to query.
If you set the TaskType parameter to DI_SOLUTION, set the FileId parameter to the ID of the data synchronization solution that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to query the ID of the real-time synchronization task or data synchronization solution
parameters.help_zh:
当TaskType为DI_REALTIME时，则FileId为实时同步任务的文件ID。
当TaskType为DI_SOLUTION时，则FileId为同步解决方案的任务ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

schema.description_zh: 数据集成同步任务返回的数据结构

Data.description_en: The status of the real-time synchronization task or data synchronization solution
Data.description_zh: 获取同步任务的运行状态

Message.description_en: The cause of the failure to obtain the status of the real-time synchronization task or data synchronization solution. If the status of the real-time synchronization task or data synchronization solution is obtained, the value null is returned
Message.description_zh: 获取同步任务运行状态失败后的原因描述。如果获取数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Name.description_en:
If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_REALTIME, the Name parameter indicates the name of the real-time synchronization task.
If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_SOLUTION, the value null is returned
Name.description_zh:
如果taskType为DI_REALTIME，则name为实时同步任务的名称。
如果taskType为DI_SOLUTION， 则name为空

SolutionInfo.description_en:
If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_REALTIME, the value null is returned.
If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_SOLUTION, the SolutionInfo parameter indicates the details of the data synchronization solution
SolutionInfo.description_zh:
如果taskType为DI_REALTIME，则SolutionInfo为空。
如果taskType为DI_SOLUTION， 则SolutionInfo为同步解决方案运行详情

CreatorName.description_en: The creator of the data synchronization solution
CreatorName.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务创建者名称

Id.description_en: The ID of the data synchronization solution

Status.description_en: The status of the data synchronization solution
Status.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行状态

StepDetail.description_en: The step details of the data synchronization solution
StepDetail.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务运行步骤详情

items.description_zh: 数据集成同步任务返回的数据结构

Info.description_en: The information of the data synchronization solution
Info.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行信息

Status.description_en: The status of the step in the data synchronization solution
Status.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行步骤的状态

StepId.description_en: The ID of the step in the data synchronization solution
StepId.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行步骤的ID

StepName.description_en: The name of the step in the data synchronization solution
StepName.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行步骤的名称

Status.description_en:
If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_REALTIME, the Status parameter indicates the status of the real-time synchronization task. Valid values: PAUSE, NORUN, RUN, KILLING, and WAIT.
If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_SOLUTION, the Status parameter indicates the status of the data synchronization solution. Valid values: success and fail
Status.description_zh:
如果taskType为DI_REALTIME，则status为实时任务的运行状态。包括：PAUSE、NORUN、RUN、KILLING、WAIT。 

如果taskType为DI_SOLUTION， 则status为同步解决方案的运行状态。包括：success、fail

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：

true：成功。 
false：失败
